page.text:
en
# Fighting for an Oakland that works for you.
DonateVolunteer
WHY I'M RUNNING
## I’m a democratic socialist whose roots start in Oakland.
I'm running for Oakland City Council in District 2 because working people deserve to run the city, not the establishment consultants, not the crypto billionaires, and not mega real estate landlords. If you're overpaying on rent, struggling with unreliable buses, or dealing with broken, unsafe streets, you're not alone. Join me in taking our city back!
Learn More About Me
Your browser does not support the video tag.
MY PLATFORM
## Slash the Rent,
Fix the Streets,
1,000 City Jobs
Our platform focuses on what affects Oakland District 2 residents most: Affordability, safety, and jobs. Our community-centered platform harnesses the power of a seat on City Council to make a difference for Oakland residents.
Read My Policies
### Housing and Affordability
While mega corporate investors are flipping properties and driving up costs, our neighbors can’t afford to stay in our town. It’s time to create permanently affordable housing for renters. Let’s also make sure families can afford their first, not watch corporations buy their thousandth.
Learn More
### Safety of Every Kind
Our city spends more on trip and fall lawsuits than we do on repairing our sidewalks. City Hall has let our streets fall into disrepair, with the most severe crashes concentrated in our district. My time in city council will be measured by potholes filled, lights repaired, and streets cleaned.
Learn More
### Expanding Care and Dignity
We have 4,000 budgeted positions in Oakland. Only 3,000 are filled due to mismanagement. These include paving crews, street ambassadors, and crossing guards. I will fight for these jobs to be advertised and filled so we can get 1,000 of our neighbors hired.
Learn More
### Accountability to the People
Our community deserves accountability and community trust. I will implement community-led governance by ensuring residents and communities set policy priorities and releasing public records. To address the fiscal crisis, I will fully staff community oversight boards to monitor spending transparently and I will work to end the Port of Oakland's role in shipping arms to conflict zones.
Learn More
## We’re funded by people, not corporations.
Every dollar you donate helps fund our movement for a more affordable, safer Oakland. Your donations go towards distributing flyers and signs, door-to-door canvassing, and hosting events to get the word out about our campaign.

Our community is ready to build an Oakland we can all be proud of. Get involved by volunteering with the campaign, attending one of our community events, donating, or even hosting your own house party to help get us to city hall!
